rationale: The post-entry candle sequence shows a clear distribution pattern — price peaked at ~18.22–18.24 immediately after entry and has made eight consecutive lower closes back to 18.10, now sitting below both the 9-EMA (18.12) and the 5-min VWAP (18.11), the two key supports cited in the original thesis. Volume on the declining candles remains elevated (50–63K) with no sign of absorption, and the positive news catalyst is now 131 minutes stale with no new headlines reinforcing momentum. The original edge has been consumed; exiting flat preserves capital and today's strong realized P&L rather than risking a slide toward invalidation.
